q: How many PTO days do I get per year?
a: Akamai employees get 20 PTO days per year, accruing at 1.67 days per month from your start date.

q: When can I start using my PTO?
a: PTO is available for use after a 30-day waiting period from your start date.

q: Does unused PTO roll over?
a: Up to 5 unused PTO days roll over to the next calendar year. Anything above 5 days as of December 31st is forfeited.

q: How do I request time off?
a: Submit PTO requests in Workday at least 7 days in advance for absences of 3+ days. Same-day requests should go directly to your manager via Slack.

q: How much sick leave do I get?
a: Akamai offers 10 days of sick leave annually. Sick leave is tracked separately from PTO and does not roll over.

q: How do I submit an expense report?
a: Submit expenses through Expensify within 30 days of the transaction date. Itemized receipts are required for any expense over $25.

q: Are alcohol expenses reimbursable?
a: Alcohol is only reimbursable when included in a client meal.

q: Whats the limit for client meals?
a: Client meals are reimbursable up to $75 per person.

q: How long does expense reimbursement take?
a: Reimbursement is processed bi-weekly via direct deposit and typically arrives 7-10 business days after approval.

q: Can I expense first class flights?
a: First-class and business-class airfare are not reimbursable without prior VP approval.

q: What if I forgot to submit an expense within 30 days?
a: Expenses submitted after 30 days require VP-level approval and may be denied.

q: When is open enrollment?
a: Open enrollment runs from November 1 through November 15 each year.

q: How long do new hires have to enroll in benefits?
a: New hires have 30 days from their start date to enroll in benefits via the Workday portal.

q: When does benefits coverage start?
a: Benefits coverage begins on the first day of the month following enrollment.

q: Does Akamai match 401k contributions?
a: Akamai matches 100% of 401(k) contributions up to 4% of salary, with immediate vesting.

q: What are the medical plan options?
a: Three tiers: Bronze (HDHP with HSA), Silver (PPO), and Gold (PPO with low deductible). Akamai covers 80% of employee premiums and 60% of dependent premiums.

q: Are dental and vision covered?
a: Yes, dental and vision are bundled together and entirely employer-paid for employees and dependents.

q: Can I change my benefits mid-year?
a: Outside of open enrollment, you can only change benefits if you experience a qualifying life event such as marriage, birth, divorce, or loss of coverage. Report qualifying events within 30 days.

q: How much parental leave does Akamai offer?
a: Akamai offers 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, regardless of gender or how the child joined the family.

q: Do birthing parents get extra leave?
a: Yes, birthing parents get an additional 6 weeks of paid medical recovery leave, for up to 22 weeks combined.

q: Can I split parental leave into multiple blocks?
a: Yes, parental leave can be taken in two blocks within the first year, with the first block being at least 4 consecutive weeks.

q: How much notice do I need to give for parental leave?
a: Notify your manager and HR at least 30 days before your planned start date when possible.

q: What time do I start on my first day?
a: Report to the office at 9:30 AM on your first day, or join the remote onboarding Zoom link sent by your recruiter.

q: What training do I need to complete in my first week?
a: Security awareness, code of conduct, data handling, and the platform overview tutorial. All are available in Workday Learning.

q: Do I get an onboarding buddy?
a: Yes, you'll be paired with an onboarding buddy from a different team to help you navigate Akamai culture.

q: What tools do I need to install on my first day?
a: Slack, Zoom, 1Password, GitHub Enterprise, and Okta. You'll also join your team's standup and complete a first PR.

q: When are deploys allowed?
a: Production deploys are allowed Monday through Thursday, 10 AM to 4 PM Pacific. No deploys on Fridays, weekends, or holidays without approved exception.

q: How do I roll back a deploy?
a: Click 'Rollback' in ArgoCD on the affected service. The rollback is automatic and takes 60-90 seconds.

q: What's the deploy pre-flight checklist?
a: Tests passing in CI, staging smoke tests green for 2+ hours, runbook updated if behavior changes, on-call notified, and feature flags configured for gradual rollout.

q: Can I deploy on a Friday?
a: No production deploys on Fridays without an approved exception in #release-approvals.

q: What deploy tool do we use?
a: Akamai uses GitOps via ArgoCD. Merging to main triggers automatic staging deploys; production requires manual approval in ArgoCD.

q: How do I declare an incident?
a: Type /incident declare in Slack. This creates a dedicated channel, pages on-call, and starts a status page draft.

q: What's the difference between SEV1 and SEV2?
a: SEV1 is total outage or data loss affecting all customers; SEV2 is a major feature broken or degradation affecting a significant fraction of users.

q: When is a postmortem required?
a: Postmortems are required for all SEV1 and SEV2 incidents and must be published within 5 business days.

q: How often do we send updates during a SEV1?
a: SEV1 updates go out every 15 minutes on the status page and in #incidents.

q: How does the on-call rotation work?
a: Each engineering team runs a weekly rotation, Monday 10 AM to the following Monday 10 AM Pacific. PagerDuty handles paging.

q: How fast do I need to acknowledge a page?
a: Within 5 minutes during business hours, 15 minutes outside business hours.

q: How much does on-call pay?
a: $200 per weekday on-call, $400 per weekend day, paid out the following pay period.

q: How do I swap an on-call shift?
a: Post in your team channel to arrange a swap, and update PagerDuty before the shift begins.

q: How many reviewers does a PR need?
a: At least one approval from a code owner. Two approvals are required for changes to authentication, payments, or core data models.

q: What's the code review SLA?
a: Reviewers should respond within one business day, or reassign / indicate when they will respond.

q: How big should my PRs be?
a: Under 400 lines of changed code where possible. Larger PRs require a description of the reviewing strategy.

q: How do I set up the VPN?
a: Akamai uses Tailscale. Download from tailscale.com or app store, sign in with your Akamai Google account via SSO, and approve the device in your authenticator.

q: Why can't I reach internal services?
a: Make sure Tailscale is running. Internal hostnames resolve via MagicDNS only when connected.

q: What VPN does Akamai use?
a: Akamai uses Tailscale for remote access to internal services.

q: How do I access the wiki?
a: Connect to Tailscale and visit wiki.cat.internal.

q: How do I reset my password?
a: On the Okta login page, click 'Need help signing in?' then 'Forgot password.' A reset link is sent to your Akamai email.

q: I lost my authenticator app, what do I do?
a: Contact IT helpdesk via #it-helpdesk Slack or extension 4357. You'll need to verify your identity through a video call with a manager or HR.

q: What are the password requirements?
a: Minimum 14 characters, including at least one number and one symbol. 1Password is recommended for unique passwords.

q: When can I get a new laptop?
a: Akamai refreshes laptops every 3 years or when hardware fails. File a ticket in #it-helpdesk with your serial number and reason.

q: What laptops can I choose from?
a: The latest 14" or 16" MacBook Pro, or a Dell XPS 15. Custom configs need manager approval.

q: My laptop is broken, what do I do?
a: Remote employees get a next-business-day replacement shipped. Return the broken device within 7 days using the prepaid label. SF and NYC offices have a small loaner pool.

q: How do I book business travel?
a: All business travel must be booked through Navan. Bookings outside Navan are not reimbursable except in emergencies with VP approval.

q: What's the meal per diem?
a: $75/day domestic, $100/day international, $125/day in NYC, SF, London, and Tokyo.

q: Can I rent a car for a business trip?
a: Yes, mid-size or smaller. Larger vehicles require justification (equipment or 3+ travelers).

q: What's the hotel rate cap?
a: $300/night domestic and $400/night international. Above these requires manager approval; conference rates are exempt.

q: How many holidays does Akamai observe?
a: 12 paid holidays per year, plus a winter shutdown from December 26 through December 30.

q: Is the day after Thanksgiving a holiday?
a: Yes, Thanksgiving and the Friday after are both observed.

q: Do we get time off between Christmas and New Year's?
a: Yes, Akamai observes a winter shutdown from December 26 through December 30. These days do not count against PTO.

q: What if a holiday falls on a weekend?
a: It is observed on the closest weekday.

q: When are all-hands meetings?
a: Every two weeks on Thursdays at 10 AM Pacific.

q: Where can I find the all-hands recording?
a: Recordings are posted to the #all-hands Slack channel within 24 hours.

q: How long is the all-hands?
a: 45 minutes, except quarterly all-hands which run 90 minutes.

q: How do I submit a question for all-hands?
a: Submit in advance via the #all-hands-questions channel or anonymously through the Pigeonhole link.
